Alina Korneeva won the girls' singles title at the 2023 French Open , defeating Lucciana Pérez Alarcón in the final, 7–6 (7–4) , 6–3. [ 1 ] Korneeva became the first player since Magdalena Maleeva in 1990 to win the first two Grand Slam events in girls' singles in the same year. [ 2 ] Lucie Havlíčková was the defending champion, but chose not to participate. [ 3 ] Seeds [ edit ] 0 1 . Sara Saito (second round) 0 2 . Clervie Ngounoue (quarterfinals) 0 3 .
